notes.id: Jam kunjung belum dikonfirmasi ke pengempon pura. Pura aktif: tertutup untuk pengunjung saat odalan dan upacara. Odalan jatuh pada Purnama Jyestha dan Purnama Kalima.
notes.en: Visiting hours have not been confirmed with the temple's custodians. This is an active temple: it closes to visitors during odalan and other ceremonies. The odalan falls on Purnama Jyestha and Purnama Kalima.

dressCode.id: Kamen dan selendang wajib. Jangan masuk halaman dalam tanpa izin pemangku, dan jangan masuk sama sekali saat cuntaka.
dressCode.en: A kamen and sash are required. Do not enter the inner courtyard without the pemangku's permission, and do not enter at all while ritually impure.

notes.id: Kebijakan foto belum dikonfirmasi ke pengempon pura. Anggap terbatas: tidak memotret di halaman dalam maupun saat ada persembahyangan.
notes.en: The photography policy has not been confirmed with the temple's custodians. Treat it as restricted: no photography in the inner courtyard or during prayer.

notes.id: Jumlah undakan belum disurvei. Halaman pura Bali umumnya berjenjang dan dipisahkan gerbang bertangga; asumsikan ada undakan tanpa pegangan dan periksa di lokasi.
notes.en: Step count has not been surveyed. Balinese temple courtyards are usually terraced and separated by stepped gateways; assume steps with no handrail and check on site.

text.id: Pura Maospahit berada di lingkungan Jl. Sutomo, Pemecutan Kaja. Bangunannya bata merah dengan langgam arsitektur Majapahit, dan tata ruangnya mengikuti konsep Panca Mandala.
text.en: Pura Maospahit sits in the Jl. Sutomo neighbourhood of Pemecutan Kaja. It is built in red brick in a Majapahit architectural idiom, and its layout follows the Panca Mandala concept.

text.id: Sumber tersier menyebut pura ini didirikan sekitar 1278 Masehi oleh Sri Kbo Iwa, lalu dipugar sekitar 1553 oleh I Pasek. Kronologi ini belum dicek terhadap sumber primer.
text.en: A tertiary source dates the temple's founding to around 1278 CE under Sri Kbo Iwa, with a restoration around 1553 by I Pasek. That chronology has not been checked against a primary source.
